page.overview:
Who is Abraham Cornelius?

When Weapon X found a Brood specimen preserved by the arctic cold, they began experiment with it in order to more effectively wipe the minds of their test subjects. The Brood eventually got out and killed or infected everyone in the facility.

Cornelius lasted long enough to be found by some of the former Team X members, who came seeking revenge. He gloated to them about the future before the Brood broke him from the inside, killing him.
